findings.title: CI geometry fixture isolation
findings.expected_actual: Synthetic geometry fixtures must not require production cgroup resources. Six tests failed on the real publication preflight outside the production launcher.
reproduction: PYTHONPATH=openhab/scripts:.ci/solar-pv/analytics/src OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 /tmp/earthship-audit-20261020-venv/bin/python -m pytest -q openhab/scripts/test_daily_pv_potential.py openhab/scripts/test_pv_legacy_history.py openhab/scripts/test_thermal_weather_conditioning.py: 6 failed, 30 passed
findings.root_cause: Test fixtures injected geometry and guard but not the publication resource boundary. The actual guard correctly refuses ordinary CI process caps.
regression_evidence: Same files plus test_household_cycle_resources.py: 101 passed in 3.41s. Test-scoped preflight injection only; production modules unchanged. Normal shard verification pending.
